import sys
import types

import numpy as np

_index = types.ModuleType("vector_index")
_index.docs = ["Refunds are accepted within 30 days of purchase.",
               "Refunds are not accepted after 30 days of purchase.",
               "Shipping is free on orders over 50 dollars."]
_vecs = np.random.default_rng(0).normal(size=(3, 8))
_index.doc_vecs = _vecs / np.linalg.norm(_vecs, axis=1, keepdims=True)


def _embed(text):
    v = np.random.default_rng(len(text)).normal(size=8)
    return v / np.linalg.norm(v)


def _rerank(question, passages):
    return [float(len(set(question.split()) & set(p.split()))) for p in passages]


_index.embed = _embed
_index.rerank = _rerank
sys.modules["vector_index"] = _index
